visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Five young individuals are stacked vertically in a line, creating a single column of faces. The front-most person is a male wearing a blue baseball cap and a grey and black Champion sweatshirt. Behind him are three more males and one female with her hair in two long pigtails. They are all positioned against a plain, brightly lit white wall in a studio setting. (2) As the music plays, the individuals start a staggered rhythmic movement. They tilt their heads and upper bodies to the left and right in a wave-like sequence. The synchronization is initially tight, with each person following the beat. The lighting is flat and bright, emphasizing their facial expressions and group coordination. (3) The movement becomes more energetic and less controlled. The group starts laughing, and the female's pigtails whip around as she moves her head vigorously. The person in the front remains focused on the camera but smiles broadly. The background remains constant and minimalist. (4) The vertical stack breaks apart as the individuals lean out to the sides, all laughing and talking. They make eye contact with the camera and with each other, showing a high level of social engagement and joy before the clip ends.

The music tempo remains steady at approximately 120 BPM, providing a rhythmic anchor for the vocal outbursts. (3) The laughter becomes more frequent and dense, overlapping heavily with the music. Distinct male shouts of "Whoa!" and "Yeah!" are audible, showing high emotional arousal and positive valence. There are no significant SFX, as the sound design relies entirely on the interplay of music and live group reaction. The signal-to-noise ratio remains high, with the primary voices and music clearly separated from any potential background floor.
